lede: Wat Phra Koet accounts for 58 catalogued manuscripts, 14 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (76%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (24%). Dated witnesses run 1749–1899 CE (13 of 58 carry a date).
